contact.name: Rasie Bamigbade
contact.evidence_quote: Hello! Meet Rasie Bamigbade, a leadership coach, book coach and speaker with 16+ years of lived experiences in Leadership and Management. She is the author of Amazon Bestsellers: “Lead In Your Truth” & “Heal On Your Terms”. ... As the founder of RB Jumpstart Coaching, her goal is to close the opportunity gap in leadership by supporting leaders in organizations with leadership training, coaching and development. She also supports authors with the construction process of their book from idea to publishing.
